The '''Roon system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]], within the [[Cloak of the Sith/Legends|Cloak of the Sith]] nebula, in the [[Abrion sector/Legends|Abrion sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] of [[Kaloo]], [[Roon/Legends|Roon]] and [[Iqoon]].
